source_doc.title: Asia Vital Components (3017) 2025 Annual Report（英文版股東會年報）
source_doc.publisher: 公開資訊觀測站（MOPS 電子書）
source_doc.permission_basis: 台灣上市公司法定申報（英文版股東會年報，與中文版同日上傳）；只保留研究必要的逐字摘錄。published_at 取 MOPS 列表上傳時間 115/05/13 17:27:04（民國年轉西元）。PDF 文字層有斷字空格，引文照頁面寫法、去空白比對。

sources.quote: The year 2025 marks the “Inaugural Year of Liquid Cooling” for AVC, where we have successfully achieved large-scale, high-reliability production of liquid cooling solutions for the AI sector.

sources.locator: Letter to Shareholders——4. Impact of the external competitive, regulatory and overall operating environment
sources.quote: Through our long-term investment in Cold Plates and Coolant Distribution Units (CDU), the company has secured a first-mover advantage.

sources.locator: Operational Highlights——4.1.1.1 The main operational categories of the company
sources.quote: AVC’s main products can be categorized into thermal products, chassis and cabinets, system assembly, and hinge products. Among them, thermal products include fans, heatsinks, heat exchangers, heat pipes/vapor chambers, 3D vapor chambers, water cooling plates, and comprehensive liquid cooling solutions.

Following the “Inaugural Year of Liquid Cooling” for AVC in 2025, we are actively pursuing large-scale capacity expansion and global deployment to consolidate and expand our market share, with a specific focus on increasing production capacity for critical cold plate components.

sources.locator: Operational Highlights——4.1.4.1 Short-term Business Development Plan (2)
sources.quote: (2).Capacity Expansion: Progressively increase production capacity for liquid cooling modules, manifold systems, and other AI server-related components to meet the rapidly accelerating demands of customers.

sources.locator: Operational Highlights——4.1.1.2 The net sales proportion of the main product of the business（UNIT: NT$ thousand; %）

claims.statement: AVC's own annual report: 2025 was AVC's 'Inaugural Year of Liquid Cooling' with large-scale, high-reliability production of AI liquid-cooling solutions; its thermal products include water cooling plates; it has 'long-term investment in Cold Plates and Coolant Distribution Units (CDU)' and is focusing capacity expansion on 'critical cold plate components'. Self-report in a statutory filing (L8: weak, costly); no customer named in these passages.
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：奇鋐後續年報、季報或法說寫出冷板擴產取消或延後；或客戶端一手顯示冷板供應商不含奇鋐。核查頻率：每季（奇鋐月營收、季報、法說）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence，重讀冷板層。

claims.statement: AVC plans to progressively increase capacity for liquid cooling modules and manifold systems for AI servers. Its 2025 net-sales table shows a single line, '3C Electronic Products' NT$139,639,362 thousand (100%) — liquid cooling is not split out. Dated context (L4).
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：奇鋐揭露歧管擴產取消，或液冷營收在拆分後占比很低。核查頻率：每季。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，重讀 manifold 層。
